description: The Board cannot direct City Administration on shopping cart theft.
It can direct Saskatoon Police Service to investigate.
The Board will send a letter to the writers.

chips.text: Cary and Sherry Tarasoff raised concerns about shopping cart theft.
City Clerk clarified Board's limited authority to direct City Administration.

description: Police and Crisis Team responded to 3,300 mental health calls, diverting 462.
The Hub unit addressed 120 high-risk cases with 10 agencies.
Housing and mental health are top challenges for vulnerable persons.

chips.text: Crowded emergency rooms and overwhelmed services hinder vulnerable persons' support.
Intimate Partner Violence Response Team is a new pilot program, similar to PACT.
More supportive housing and mental health outreach are critical needs.
Vulnerable persons often lack resources to navigate complex support systems.

description: Saskatoon Police Service maintains high compliance with contact interview policy.
Policy requires voluntary interviews, prohibits discrimination.

chips.text: Commissioner questioned tracking of charges resulting from contact interviews.
Members of the public, especially those needing assistance, are affected by policy.
Whether all policy violations leading to dropped charges are tracked remains unclear.
Policy prohibits contact interviews based on race, gender, or other protected characteristics.
